title: The runtime renders the position packet for the claude and codex hosts, with a receipt
summary: @inventarch/runtime exports renderHost(host, packet, digest, hostNote, target) and PACKET_MARKER from the package root and the new @inventarch/runtime/internal/packet-host subpath, with the PacketHost ('claude' | 'codex'), PacketTarget ('repository' | 'consumer'), HostFile, PacketReceipt and HostOutput types. renderHost renders one position packet, with the digest and host note renderPacket returned, as the host's files and returns the frozen HostOutput {files, receipt}; it reads no workspace and writes, deletes or plans no file. No host gets an agent file. claude renders .claude/rules/ia-workspace.md and .claude/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md for a consumer workspace, and CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md for the repository target; codex renders AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/ia-authoring/SKILL.md for either. Every file carries the marker `<!-- Generated by ia project; edit the cited native records. -->`, first in the entry file and after each SKILL.md's YAML frontmatter, and each ia-authoring skill keeps the text the compliance renderers write for that target, its marker line aside. The entry file holds the packet's sections in the packet's field order (seat, participants, mandates, system pointer lines, captured-record tallies, intent table, phase table, command catalog, SPEC lines), plain Markdown with one entry per list item or table row, so it renders entryCount(packet) entries, byte-identical for both hosts; then the line `ia-generated <revision> <packet digest> <adapter>`, where the adapter is ia-claude or ia-codex and names the package version (`ia-claude@<version>`) only in the consumer target, so a committed repository file does not change when a release bumps the version; then, in the consumer target only, a 'Host note (not part of the packet)' section with the freshness, installed state and key. The receipt, format ia.packet-receipt.v1, holds host, adapter (id@version in either target), revision, packetDigest, bodyDigest, entries, files (each rendered file's path and the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 text), removed, foreign, guard, hostNote, participants and mandates (the packet's `@agent` and `@mandate` identities) and writtenAt. An unknown host or target, or a digest that is not the packet's, is refused with IA-RUNTIME-REQUEST-INVALID. Limits: renderHost leaves removed and foreign empty, guard 'none' and writtenAt null for the caller that writes the files to set; no CLI command or generator calls it yet, so ia host and the repository projections keep their current renderers and files; the receipt carries no CLI version, no source digests and no per-command consumer versions; compliance is unchanged.
